master_profile.summary_source: Entry-level AI engineer with internship experience building LLM applications in Python. Comfortable taking a retrieval feature from prototype to a deployed FastAPI service.

bullets.text: Built a RAG chatbot over 1,200 internal support documents using LangChain and FastAPI, cutting average answer lookup time from 6 minutes to under 1 minute.
bullets.metric: lookup time from 6 minutes to under 1 minute; 1,200 documents

bullets.text: Responsible for writing prompt templates for the support assistant.
Added an evaluation script that scored 150 question-answer pairs for groundedness, catching 18 hallucinated answers before release.
Built a FastAPI service that answers questions over uploaded PDFs using embeddings stored in PostgreSQL with pgvector.
Containerised the service with Docker and deployed it with a GitHub Actions pipeline.
Worked on a Python script that ranks resumes against a job description using sentence-transformer embeddings.

components.name: parseability
components.why: Single column, standard section names and plain bullets parse cleanly. Dates are consistent. The contact line packs five items into one row, which some parsers split badly.

components.name: keyword coverage
components.why: RAG, LangChain, FastAPI and LLM evaluation are present. Agents, tool calling, vector database and CI/CD never appear, although the work described would justify the last two.

components.name: impact bullets
components.why: Two of six bullets carry a measured result. Two open with weak verbs and state a duty. Two describe what was built with no outcome.

components.name: structure/consistency
components.why: Sections are in a sensible order. JavaScript, SQL and Git are listed as skills but no bullet shows them being used.

components.name: length/density
components.why: The page is about two thirds full. One internship and two projects leave room for more detail on each.

weak_bullets.problem: Opens with "Responsible for" and states a duty. It gives no result and no scale.
weak_bullets.rewrite: Wrote the prompt templates used by the support assistant.
weak_bullets.needs_from_user: How many templates did you write, and did answer quality change after you introduced them? Give a number only if you measured one.

weak_bullets.problem: Opens with "Worked on", which hides what you personally built. It gives no result.
weak_bullets.rewrite: Built a Python script that ranks resumes against a job description using sentence-transformer embeddings.
weak_bullets.needs_from_user: How many resumes did you run it on, and how did its ranking compare with a manual one?

top_gaps.gap: No public demo or repository link for any project
top_gaps.blocks: A reviewer cannot check the RAG and FastAPI claims, which are the core of every target role.
top_gaps.smallest_action: Push DocQuery to a public repository, deploy it on a free tier and put both links on the resume.

top_gaps.gap: Five months of experience from a single internship
top_gaps.blocks: Postings that ask for one or more years will screen this resume out.
top_gaps.smallest_action: Target roles marked entry, graduate or intern-to-hire, and expand the internship bullets with scope.

top_gaps.gap: JavaScript, SQL and Git are listed with no supporting bullet
top_gaps.blocks: An interviewer will probe them, and unsupported skills weaken the supported ones.
top_gaps.smallest_action: Add one bullet that shows each in use, or remove them from the skills line.

top_gaps.blocks: AI Engineer postings increasingly list agents as a requirement.
top_gaps.smallest_action: Add one tool-calling feature to DocQuery and describe it in a bullet.

top_gaps.gap: Cloud knowledge is a certificate only
top_gaps.blocks: Postings that ask for hands-on AWS will not count a fundamentals certificate.
top_gaps.smallest_action: Deploy DocQuery on AWS and name the services used.

overall_verdict: A credible entry-level profile for Generative AI Developer roles: the internship shows a real RAG system with measured results. It is held back by two duty-style bullets, three skills with nothing behind them and no link a reviewer can click. Fix the links first; that is one evening of work.
